blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The scarcity of positive cases remains a major bottleneck in developing automated diagnostic systems for fetal Congenital Heart Defects~(CHDs), particularly for rare subtypes. Although normal cases are accessible with effort, positive cases are hard to collect due to low incidence rates and privacy concerns, causing severe class imbalance or absence of positive training samples. Existing works resort to synthesizing positives with conditional generative models, but they are task-specific and require positive training samples, hindering application for fetal CHDs. To this end, we propose a positive-free mask-guided counterfactual generation framework for fetal echocardiography, namely Pos4CHD, which enables realistic, high-quality synthesis of pseudo-positive samples from semantic masks, with only normal samples at hand. Technically, we first develop FE-Gen, a mask-guided generative model tailored for fetal heart ultrasound synthesis that mitigates histogram drift and enhances image-mask spatial alignment. Building on FE-Gen, Pos4CHD employs a mask-to-image generation paradigm for CHD synthesis. It first manipulates semantic masks to simulate fetal-heart structural anomalies and then renders anatomically consistent images. Extensive experiments on in-house datasets, together with expert evaluations, demonstrate the visual fidelity~($-12.97$ FID) and anatomical consistency~($+3.96\%$ DSC) of synthesized images. Further validations across diverse real-world CHD diagnosis tasks exhibit promising results and consistent increments, including zero-shot classification~(achieving $93.25\%$ ACC on EbA and $72.92\%$ ACC on TAPVC), lesion detection~($+6.95\%$ mAP50 on VSD), and anatomy segmentation~($+10.49\%$ DSC on fetal heart) compared with baselines. Codes and models are publicly available on \href{https://github.com/DREAMXFAR/Pos4CHD}{GitHub}.
blocks.zh: 阳性病例的稀缺仍然是开发胎儿先天性心脏缺陷(CHD)的自动诊断系统的一个主要瓶颈,对于罕见的亚型而言尤其如此。 虽然可以努力找到正常病例,但由于发生率低和隐私问题,很难收集到阳性病例,造成严重的班级不平衡或缺乏阳性培训样本。 现有作品采用有条件的基因模型合成阳性,但都是任务特异性的,需要阳性训练样本,阻碍了胎儿的CHD的应用. 为此,我们提出了胎儿回声心电图的无阳性口罩制导反事实生成框架,即Pos4CHD,它能够对来自语义口罩的伪阳性样本进行现实,高质量的合成,只有普通的样本在手. 从技术上讲,我们首先开发了FE-Gen,这是一种为胎儿心脏超声合成量身定制的蒙面导基因模型,可以缓解直方图漂移,增强图像-面具空间对齐. 在FE-Gen的基础上,Pos4CHD采用了CHD合成的面具到图像生成范式. 它首先操纵语义面具来模拟胎儿-心脏结构异常,然后使解剖学上一致的图像. 对内部数据集的广泛实验,连同专家评价,证明了合成图像的视觉可靠性~(12.97美元FID)和解剖一致性~(+3.96美元DSC). 对各种现实世界的CDD诊断任务的进一步验证显示出有希望的结果和连续不断的增量,包括零镜头分类(EbA的ACC为93.25美元,TAPVC的ACC为72.92美元),损伤检测~(VSD的+6.95\%mAP50美元)以及解剖学分解~(胎儿心脏的+10.49\%DSC)与基线比较。 代码和模型在\href{上公开 https://github.com/DREAMXFAR/Pos4CHD+GitHub} (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Paradigm comparison for (a) class/text-, (b) layout-, (c) mask-guided medical counterfactual synthesis. Since CHDs are structural anomalies, we employ a mask-guided paradigm for fetal CHD synthesis without positive training samples, providing dense structural guidance, fine spatial alignment, and interpretability for downstream analysis.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:(a)类/文本-,(b)布局-,(c)口罩制导医学反事实合成的范式比较. 自兹 CHD是结构异常,我们采用一个遮罩-导范式进行胎儿CHD合成,没有正向训练样品,提供密集的结构取向,细微的空间相接,以及下游分析的可解释性.

blocks.en: Fetal congenital heart defects (CHDs), characterized by heterogeneous structural anomalies, are one of the leading causes of infant mortality, which affects approximately 0.8 0.8 ∼ \sim 1.0 % 1.0\% of live births [ 1 , 2 ] . Fetal echocardiography, i.e. , fetal heart ultrasound, is the primary tool for prenatal examination due to its radiation-free, low-cost, and real-time nature. Clinicians typically examine fetal heart anatomical structures using standardized cardiac views [ 3 ] like the Four-Chamber (4CH) view, Three-Vessel and Trachea (3VT) view, etc. , which provide essential and vital references for cardiac function analysis. This practice helps early detection and diagnosis of various CHD subtypes, including Ebstein’s Anomaly (EbA), Total Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Connection (TAPVC), Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD), etc. , contributing to improved worldwide pregnancy healthcare [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 胎儿先天性心脏缺陷(CHDs),其特点是结构异常多样,是导致婴儿死亡的主要原因之一,它影响了大约0.8 0.8\sim 1.0%活胎[1,2]. 胎儿回声心电图,即胎儿心脏超声波,由于其无辐射,低成本和实时的性质,是产前检查的主要工具. 临床医生一般利用标准化的心动视图来检查胎儿心脏解剖结构[3],如"四合院"(4CH)视图,"三维塞尔"和"管风琴"(3VT)视图等,为心脏功能分析提供了重要而关键的参考. 这种做法有助于早期发现和诊断各种CHD子类型,包括Ebstein的Anomaly(EbA),Total Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Connection(TAPVC),Ventricular Septal Defect(VSD)等,有助于改善全球的妊娠保健[4].

blocks.en:
However, compared with existing AI systems for MRI, CT, and X-rays [ 5 ] , AI-assisted fetal CHD detection and analysis remains underdeveloped due to severe data scarcity, which stems from: (1) the acquisition of standardized fetal cardiac views requires expertise and experience, (2) varied view quality across operators and examinations, and (3) cardiac anatomical annotation is labor-intensive and requires expertise, resulting in few high-quality public datasets. More importantly, given the wide range of CHD subtypes ( ≥ \geq 27 27 ), although normal cases are accessible through clinical efforts, positive cases for rare CHDs are often out of reach owing to low incidence rates ( < < 1 / 10,000 1/10,000 ) [ 2 ] and privacy constraints.
This positive-sample scarcity hinders the training of downstream models, leading to severe class imbalance and potential generalization issues [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
然而,与现有的核磁共振、CT和X射线的人工智能系统[5]相比,由于数据严重短缺,人工辅助胎儿的CHD检测和分析仍然不发达,其原因有:(1) 获得标准化胎儿心脏观点需要专门知识和经验;(2) 操作者和检查者的观点质量不同;(3) 心脏解剖注释是劳动密集型的,需要专业技术,导致很少高质量的公共数据集。 更重要的是,鉴于CHD亚型(\\\ geq 27 27)的范围很广,虽然通过临床努力可以接触正常病例,但由于发病率低( < 1/10,000 1/10,000)[2]和隐私限制,罕见CHD的阳性病例往往无法达到.
这种正向-抽样的稀缺性阻碍了下游模式的培训,导致严重的阶级不平衡和潜在的通化问题 [6].

blocks.en:
Recent advances in generative models, e.g. , diffusion models, offer a promising solution to medical data scarcity via image synthesis. Existing studies focused on improving image fidelity [ 7 , 8 ] and anatomical plausibility [ 9 , 10 ] across different imaging modalities, and adapting generative foundation models for medical applications [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] .
Conditional generative models, e.g. , Stable Diffusion (SD) [ 14 ] and ControlNet [ 15 ] , further enable task-specific conditional guidance to synthesize images with desired properties. Practices (see Fig. 1 ) include class labels or text prompts [ 16 , 17 ] for anatomical description, layouts [ 18 ] for lesion position and size, segmentation masks [ 19 , 20 ] for structure and shape, with optional reference images [ 21 , 22 ] to provide extra context for local variations. Such methods can produce paired image-condition data for augmentation purposes and benefit various downstream tasks including classification, segmentation, and multi-center generalization [ 10 , 23 ] . Recent counterfactual synthesis explores generating positive cases, such as tumors [ 24 ] , thyroid cancers [ 25 ] , breast lesions [ 26 ] , etc .
blocks.zh:
遗传模型,例如扩散模型,最近的进展,通过图像合成,为医疗数据稀缺提供了一个很有希望的解决办法。 现有研究的重点是改善图像忠贞性[7,8]和不同成像模式的解剖学可信性[9,10],并调整医学应用的基因基础模型[11,12,13].
有条件的基因模型,例如:稳定分化(SD)[14]和ControlNet[15],进一步使特定任务有条件的指导能够以所期望的特性来合成图像. 做法(见图1)包括解剖描述的分类标签或文字提示[16,17],损伤位置和大小的布局[18],结构与形状的分化口罩[19,20],可选参考图像[21,22],为局部变化提供额外的上下文. 这些方法可以产生成对的图像条件数据,用于增强目的,并有利于各种下游任务,包括分类、分化和多中心归纳[10、23]。 最近反事实合成探索产生阳性病例,如肿瘤[24],甲状腺癌[25],乳腺损伤[26]等.

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, directly applying such approaches to fetal CHD synthesis remains challenging.
First, most works are designed for specific tasks and limited scenarios. We need to redesign a framework for fetal CHD synthesis, where the complicated cardiac anatomy and heterogeneous CHD subtypes raise the complexity. Second, current methods [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] require positive samples to learn lesion-specific textures and structures, implicitly assuming the availability of positive cases. But this assumption is violated because of the absence of fetal CHD samples, particularly for rare subtypes.
Third, existing works lack fine-grained control over synthesized images. As shown in Fig. 1 , given that CHDs are mostly structural anomalies, the class labels and text prompts offer limited spatial control, where the anatomical plausibility of synthesized positives depends on generative priors and is hardly guaranteed. Though bounding boxes offer locations and enable simulation of position and size variations, they still fall short in depicting morphology and fine-grained variations, thus insufficient to distinguish anatomical differences across CHD subtypes.
Therefore, we raise the question: can we design a unified framework to synthesize realistic and anatomy-consistent samples of diverse CHD subtypes for downstream analysis, with only negative samples at hand?
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但直接将这类方法应用于胎儿的氯氢合成仍然具有挑战性。
首先,大多数作品都是为特定任务和有限的情景而设计的. 我们需要重新设计胎儿的CHD合成框架,其中复杂的心脏解剖学和异性的CHD亚型提高了复杂性. 第二,现行方法[24、25、26]需要阳性样本来学习与损伤有关的纹理和结构,并隐含地假定有阳性病例。 但这一假设被违反,因为没有胎儿的CHD样本,特别是对于稀有的亚型.
第三,现有作品缺乏对合成图像的精细控制. 如图一所示,鉴于CHD大多是结构异常,类标签和文本提示提供了有限的空间控制,其中合成正态的解剖学合理性依赖于基因前缀,几乎得不到保证. 虽然边框提供了位置并能够模拟位置和大小变化,但它们在描绘形态学和细纹变化方面仍然不足,因此不足以区分不同CHD亚型的解剖差异.
因此,我们提出一个问题:我们能否设计一个统一的框架,以合成现实的,符合解剖学的多种CHD亚型样本,进行下游分析,只掌握有负的样本?

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose Pos4CHD , a positive-free mask-guided counterfactual synthesis framework for fetal CHD analysis. Firstly, considering the absence of publicly available datasets, we collect ∼ \sim 8k fetal 4CH views and ∼ \sim 500 500 expert-annotations covering 14 key anatomical structures (Sec. III-C1 ), and train FE-Gen (Sec. III-C2 ), a mask-conditioned generator for fetal echocardiography, which features: 1) learnable semantic queries that enhance the spatial alignment between synthesized images and conditioning masks, and 2) a regularization term that mitigates the histogram drift when adapting diffusion models for ultrasound with improved image fidelity.
Building on FE-Gen, Pos4CHD (Sec. III-B ) utilizes a mask-to-image generation strategy to synthesize fetal CHDs from normal samples. Specifically, it first manipulates cardiac masks to simulate structural anomalies with respect to clinical prior knowledge, realizing rule-based counterfactual mask generation for fetal CHDs. Then, FE-Gen renders corresponding echocardiographic images guided by masks, yielding spatially aligned pseudo-positive samples. These synthesized samples are subsequently utilized to augment downstream training data after quality checking.
Experiments and expert evaluations demonstrate the image fidelity and anatomical consistency of FE-Gen (Sec. IV-B1 ).
Extensive experiments on real-world scenarios, including zero-shot EbA/TAPVC classification, VSD detection, and fetal cardiac anatomy segmentation, verify the effectiveness of Pos4CHD, which not only enables training models without real positives but also consistently outperforms the baseline (Sec. IV-B2 ). Notably, models trained solely on synthesized data can generalize well to real samples.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出"Pos4CHD",作为胎儿CHD分析的正无口罩制导反事实合成框架. 首先,考虑到没有公开的数据集,我们收集了\\ sim 8k featal 4CH 视图和\ sim 500 专家说明,涉及14个关键解剖结构(Sec. III-C1),并培训FE-Gen(Sec. III-C2),这是胎儿回声心电图的一个带口罩的生成器,其特点是: 1)可学习的语义查询,可以增强合成图像和调制口罩之间的空间相接性;2)一个规范化术语,在为超声波调整扩散模型时,可以以更好的图像忠心度来缓解直径漂移.
在FE-Gen的基础上,Pos4CHD (Sec. III-B)利用口罩到图像生成策略从正常样品中合成胎儿的心电图. 具体而言,它首先操纵心脏口罩来模拟与临床前科知识有关的结构异常,实现基于规则的反事实口罩对胎儿的CHD的生成. 然后,FE-Gen用口罩来制取相应的回声心电图图像,产生空间对齐的伪阳性样本. 这些综合样品随后被用于在质量检查后增加下游培训数据。
实验和专家评价证明了FE-Gen(四-B1.ec.)的图像忠贞性和解剖一致性.
关于现实世界情景的广泛实验,包括零射出EbA/TAPVC分类,VSD检测和胎儿心脏解剖学分解,验证了Pos4CHD的有效性,这不仅使得培训模型没有真正的阳性,而且持续地超过了基线(Sec. IV-B2). 值得注意的是,仅接受过综合数据培训的模型能够很好地概括到真实的样本。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: 1) We develop Pos4CHD , a positive-free mask-to-image counterfactual generation framework to tackle the scarcity of fetal CHD cases, especially rare subtypes, which offers pseudo-positive image-mask pairs for diverse CHDs through rule-based counterfactual mask manipulation and mask-guided fetal ultrasound synthesis. 2) We collect normal fetal 4CH-view datasets with rich pixel-level anatomical annotation. Based on the collected data, we train FE-Gen , a mask-guided generative model for fetal echocardiography, realizing improved ultrasound fidelity and advanced image-mask alignment. 3) Experiments together with expert evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our synthesized samples for data augmentation across various downstream tasks, bringing consistent improvements on zero-shot CHD classification, lesion detection, and fetal heart anatomy segmentation. Detailed ablations and discussions provide valuable insights to the community on how to obtain and utilize the synthesized positive samples with our method.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 1)我们开发了"Pos4CHD",这是一个正向无口罩到图像反相反相生成框架,以解决胎儿心反相多发病例的稀缺性,尤其是罕见的子型,通过基于规则的反相口罩操纵和由口罩制导的胎儿超相声合成,为多发性心反相多发性口罩提供伪正相相. 2)我们收集了普通的胎儿4CH-视图数据集,其中含有丰富的像素级解剖注释. 基于收集到的数据,我们培养了FE-Gen,这是胎儿回声心电图的口罩导基因模型,实现了更好的超声波忠诚度和先进的图像-镜像相接性. 3) 实验和专家评价表明,我们合成的样本在各种下游任务中数据增强的有效性,在零发的CHD分类、损伤检测和胎儿心脏解剖学分解方面带来了一致的改进。 详细叙述和讨论为社区提供了如何用我们的方法获取和利用综合正样本的宝贵见解。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Medical Image Generation
blocks.zh: II-A 医疗图像生成

blocks.en:
Medical image generation has been widely explored to alleviate the scarcity, limited accessibility, and high acquisition costs of data across different modalities [ 5 ] . Following early GAN-based approaches, diffusion models have become the primary choice for high image fidelity and training stability nowadays. Recent studies moved beyond visual realism toward medical-specific challenges, including anatomical fidelity [ 9 , 20 , 10 ] , few-shot adaptation [ 12 , 13 ] , and privacy preservation.
Recently, controllable generation has gained increasing attention for downstream clinical applications. By incorporating conditions like patient metadata [ 16 ] , modalities and styles [ 27 ] , pathological states [ 28 ] , and anatomical layouts or masks [ 19 , 24 ] , conditional generative models enable targeted synthesis of samples with desired characteristics. Such synthetic samples are privacy-friendly, valuable for mitigating class imbalance, enriching data diversity, and improving the robustness and generalization of medical AI models.
blocks.zh:
已广泛探索医疗图像生成,以缓解不同模式的数据稀缺、获取有限和获取成本高的情况。 采用基于全球网络的早期方法,传播模式已成为当今高度形象忠诚和培训稳定性的主要选择。 最近的研究超越了视觉现实主义,转向医学特有的挑战,包括解剖忠诚[9,20,10],几发改编[12,13],以及隐私保护.
最近,对下游临床应用而言,可控生成越来越受关注. 通过纳入病人元数据[16]、模式和样式[27]、病理状态[28]、解剖布局或口罩[19、24]等条件,有条件的基因模型能够有针对性地合成具有理想特征的样本。 这种合成样品是方便隐私的,对减轻阶级不平衡,丰富数据多样性,提高医学AI模型的稳健性和通俗性很有价值.

blocks.en: II-B Ultrasound Image Generation
blocks.zh: 二-B 超声波图像生成

blocks.en: Ultrasound image generation attracts growing attention due to its broad clinical use and distinctive imaging characteristics. Recent studies incorporated physical priors [ 7 ] and structural constraints [ 29 , 30 ] to improve fidelity. Controllable ultrasound generation has also been explored for downstream applications, such as augmenting image-mask pairs for segmentation [ 31 ] and enriching data diversity [ 32 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh: 超声波图像的生成因其广泛的临床用途和独特的成像特征而吸引了越来越多的关注. 最近的研究纳入了身体前科[7]和结构限制[29,30],以提高忠诚度。 还为下游应用探索了可控制的超声波生成,如为分解而增强图像-掩码对[31]并丰富数据多样性[32,33].

blocks.en:
Fetal ultrasound generation is a crucial research direction.
FU-LoRA [ 34 ] and DiFUSAL [ 35 ] fine-tuned SD for text-conditioned fetal ultrasound synthesis to enhance plane classification and gestational age prediction.
FVEDM [ 36 ] combines image inpainting with semantic masks and edge guidance to introduce localized variations to 4CH views, thereby enriching appearance diversity for CHD classification.
FetalFlex [ 18 ] employs masked inpainting with anatomical layouts and global prompts for multi-plane fetal ultrasound synthesis.
Although similar to FetalFlex in motivation, we adopt a fine-grained mask-to-image paradigm for ultrasound synthesis to achieve precise spatial control, and we mitigate the histogram shift to improve fidelity. Besides, Pos4CHD targets the more challenging fetal CHD synthesis for downstream analysis, where fine-grained anatomical fidelity is critical for distinguishing heterogeneous subtypes with complex cardiac structures.
blocks.zh:
胎儿超声波生成是一个关键的研究方向.
FU-LORA [34]和DiFUSAL [35] 为文字条件的胎儿超声合成而微调了SD,以强化平面分类和孕期预测.
FVEDM [36] 将图像涂装与语义口罩和边缘向导相结合,将局部变化引入4CH视图,从而丰富了CHD分类的外观多样性.
FetalFlex [18] 使用有解剖布局和多平面胎儿超声波合成全球诱因的蒙面涂装.
虽然在动机上与FetalFlex相似,但我们采用了一种精细的口罩到图像范式来进行超声波合成,以达到精确的空间控制,我们缓解了直方图的转变来提高忠诚. 此外,Pos4CHD针对的是更具有挑战性的胎儿CHD合成来进行下游分析,其中精细的解剖忠心对于区分具有复杂心脏结构的异质亚型至关重要.

blocks.en: II-C Counterfactual Synthesis
blocks.zh: 二-C 反事实综合

blocks.en:
Counterfactual synthesis produces hypothetical images by altering specific attributes of an existing sample while preserving its remaining characteristics, corresponding to what-if interventions as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Such counterfactual samples are valuable for model robustness evaluation and interpretation, anomaly detection, and data augmentation. This paper focuses on augmenting positive cases. Existing works typically rely on conditional generation or image editing [ 21 , 22 ] to synthesize positives, guided by class labels or text prompts [ 37 , 38 ] , or spatial conditions like edges, layouts, and masks [ 39 , 40 ] in Fig. 1 . However, disease-specific synthesis usually requires pathological samples or supervision to learn appearance and structural characteristics associated with the target disease. For example, Tiger [ 25 ] performs text-guided synthesis to augment rare thyroid cancer subtypes but requires cancer samples to train the generative model. This dependency restricts applicability to diseases like fetal CHDs, where positive cases are scarce and infeasible to collect.
Therefore, Pos4CHD targets subtype-specific fetal CHD synthesis, characterized by structural anomalies, using only normal samples. Combining rule-based mask manipulation and mask-guided ultrasound synthesis, Pos4CHD enables fine-grained modeling and synthesis of heterogeneous CHD subtypes with verifiable semantic masks for clinical applications.

blocks.en: III-B Pos4CHD: A Positive-free Mask-to-image Counter- factual Generation Framework for Fetal CHD Analysis
blocks.zh: III-B Pos4CHD:无正面相模反事实生成框架 胎儿相模相模分析

blocks.en: Given the scarcity or absence of fetal CHD cases, directly learning disease-specific appearance and structures from positives is infeasible. Thus, we formulate CHD synthesis as mask-to-image counterfactual generation, where semantic masks explicitly encode CHD-related anatomical changes and guide the synthesis of positive samples. This scheme supports generation of diverse CHD subtypes within a unified framework.
blocks.zh: 鉴于胎儿缺血症病例,直接从阳性中学习疾病特有的外观和结构是不可行的。 因此,我们把CHD合成制成口罩到图像反事实生成,其中语义口罩明确编码了与CHD相关的解剖变化,并指导正样品的合成. 这个方案支持在一个统一的框架内生成多种CHD子类型.

blocks.en: The pipeline of Pos4CHD is shown in Fig. 2 , which consists of five steps: (1) normal mask collection, (2) counterfactual mask manipulation, (3) pseudo-positive image synthesis, (4) quality check and data filtering, and (5) downstream utilization. The implementation of each step is depicted as follows.
blocks.zh: Pos4CHD的管道在图2中显示,由五个步骤组成:(1)正常口罩收集,(2)反事实口罩操纵,(3)伪正图像合成,(4)质量检查和数据过滤,(5)下游使用. 每个步骤的执行情况如下:

blocks.en:
We begin with a set of normal fetal cardiac masks, denoted as ℳ \mathcal{M} = = { 𝐦 i } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{m}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} , obtained through manual annotation, pretrained segmentation models, or atlas animations. These masks serve as the basis for counterfactual sample synthesis.
Given a target fetal CHD subtype c c ∈ \in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , we first design morphological transformation rules R ⁡ ( ⋅ , c , ψ c ) R(\cdot,c;\psi_{c}) based on clinical prior knowledge, thereby simulating plausible counterfactual masks with subtype-specific characteristics through operations like translations, editing, free-form deformation, etc. , where ψ c \psi_{c} denotes category-specific transformation hyperparameters.
Specifically, this paper focuses on three representative heterogeneous subtypes, i.e., EbA, TAPVC, and VSD. Their key morphological properties [ 41 ] and corresponding manipulation rules are summarized in Fig. 2 .
Next, we apply customized transformation R ⁡ ( ⋅ , c , ψ c ) R(\cdot,c;\psi_{c}) to the normal mask 𝐦 \mathbf{m} , yielding counterfactual cardiac mask 𝐦 ¯ \overline{\mathbf{m}} . This clinical-knowledge-driven counterfactual mask manipulation is formulated as, 𝐦 ¯ = R ⁡ ( 𝐦 , c , ψ c ) . \overline{\mathbf{m}}=R(\mathbf{m},c;\psi_{c}). (5)

Given the counterfactual mask 𝐦 ¯ \overline{\mathbf{m}} , we employ a mask-guided conditional generative model 𝒢 ⁡ ( ϵ , 𝐦 ) \mathcal{G}(\epsilon,\mathbf{m}) to generate spatially aligned, realistic fetal echocardiographic images, where the synthesis of the pseudo-positive image I ¯ \overline{I} is formulated as, I ¯ = 𝒢 ⁡ ( ϵ , 𝐦 ¯ ) , ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝑰 ) , \overline{I}=\mathcal{G}(\epsilon,\overline{\mathbf{m}}),\ \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(\boldsymbol{0},\boldsymbol{I}), (6) where we employ a customized generator, FE-Gen (see Sec. III-C ), for advanced image fidelity and image-mask alignment for fetal ultrasound synthesis. Following the pipeline in Fig. 2 , we can produce diverse candidate pseudo-positive image-mask pairs ( I ¯ , 𝐦 ¯ ) (\overline{I},\overline{\mathbf{m}}) for CHD subtypes, owing to the randomness of mask manipulation, augmentations, and image generation.

Then, we inspect and filter low-quality synthesized samples ( I ¯ , 𝐦 ¯ ) (\overline{I},\overline{\mathbf{m}}) manually or with pretrained segmentation models to construct a high-quality synthetic dataset 𝒟 ¯ \mathcal{\overline{D}} = = { ( I ¯ i , 𝐦 ¯ i ) } i = 1 N ′ \{(\overline{I}_{i},\overline{\mathbf{m}}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N^{\prime}} of pseudo-positives with pixel-level annotations. IV-C4 . The resulting image-mask pairs can be readily converted into class labels or bounding boxes, supporting diverse real-world CHD analysis tasks.

blocks.en: III-C FE-Gen: A Mask-guided Controllable Generation Model for Fetal Echocardiography
blocks.zh: III-C FE-Gen:胎儿回声心电图的外罩制导可控生成模型

blocks.en:
As discussed above, Pos4CHD enables CHD synthesis using only negative cases, but its performance relies on the quality of mask-to-image generator 𝒢 ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{G}(\cdot) , where two key factors matter: (1) image fidelity , which decides how closely the synthesized fetal echocardiographic images match the real ones in visual appearance and data distribution; and (2) spatial alignment between each synthesized image and conditioning mask, which determines the faithfulness of CHD-specific characteristics and mask accuracy. Poor spatial alignment would introduce noisy labels, thereby degrading downstream performance and data efficiency. Therefore, an effective generator should produce realistic fetal heart ultrasound with precise image-mask alignment.
The implementation details are as follows.
blocks.zh:
如上所讨论,Pos4CHD只使用负数来进行CHD合成,但其性能依赖于口罩到图像生成器G → (⋅)\ mathcal{G} (\cdot)的质量,其中有两个关键因素: (1)图像忠心度,它决定了被合成的胎儿回声心镜图像在视觉外观和数据分布中与真实的图像相匹配程度; (2)每个被合成的图像和配置口罩之间的空间相接,这决定了CHD特定特征和口罩的准确性. 空间协调不当将带来吵闹的标签,从而降低下游的性能和数据效率。 因此,一个有效的生成器应产生具有精确图像-相框对齐性的现实胎儿心脏超声波.
执行细节如下。

blocks.en: III-C 1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 数据收集

blocks.en:
Due to the lack of public fetal echocardiography data, we collect an in-house dataset of fetal heart ultrasound from the hospital, namely WHU-4CH-8k . This dataset contains 7,974 7,974 fetal heart 4CH views from 2,855 2,855 patients acquired between 2017 and 2023, mostly ranging from 21-23 and 28-30 gestational weeks, after plane quality checks [ 43 ] . This unlabeled dataset is utilized to train the fetal ultrasound generator.
We further select 517 517 high-quality samples and annotate 14 key anatomical structures with clinical experts, namely WHU-4CH-Seg517 .
As shown in Fig. 3 , the rich semantic annotations on 4CH views provide anatomical and spatial guidance to the generator, supporting simulation of CHD subtypes associated with these structures. More details, including data splits and resolution, are provided in Sec. IV-A .
blocks.zh:
由于缺乏公共胎儿回声心电图数据,我们从医院收集了一套胎儿心脏超声波的内部数据集,即WHU-4CH-8k. 本数据集收录了2017年至2023年间从2,855,2,855名患者获得的7,974,7,974胎心4CH视图,大多在飞机质量检查[43]后从21-23到28-30个妊娠周不等. 该无标签数据集用于训练胎儿超声波发生器.
我们还选择了517 517个高质量样本,并用临床专家,即WHU-4CH-Seg517,对14个关键解剖结构进行了注释。
如图3所显示,关于4CH视图的丰富的语义说明为生成器提供了解剖和空间指导,支持了与这些结构相关的CHD子类型的模拟. 更多细节,包括数据分割和分辨率,载于第IV-A节。

blocks.en: III-C 2 FE-Gen Architecture
blocks.zh: III-C 2 FE-Gen 建筑

blocks.en:
Following recent practices [ 18 , 12 , 8 ] , a straightforward approach is to adapt SD for fetal ultrasound synthesis. However, we notice two limitations during implementation: (1) Histogram distribution drift : generated images tend to be low-contrast and blurry, with histogram distributions deviating from real ultrasound as shown in Fig. 6 , which remains under-explored in previous literature; (2) Sub-optimal image-mask alignment : Recent studies [ 18 ] neglect quantitative measurement of spatial alignment between generated images and conditions, and conventional binary or RGB embeddings for spatial guidance may interfere with anatomy semantics and degrade spatial control precision.
To address these issues, we propose FE-Gen , which is tailored for high-fidelity and spatially consistent fetal ultrasound synthesis with two key designs: 1) learnable semantic queries, and 2) histogram distribution regularization. Details are as follows.
blocks.zh:
遵循最近的做法[18,12,8],一个直截了当的方法是使SD适用于胎儿超声波合成. 然而,我们注意到执行过程中有两个限制: (1)直方图分布漂移:生成的图像往往相距低而模糊,其直方图分布与图6所示真实超声差相去甚远,在以往文献中仍没有得到充分的探索; (2)图像-相框比对: 最近的研究[18]忽略了对所生成的图像和条件之间的空间相接的定量测量,常规的二进制或RGB嵌入用于空间引导可能干扰解剖语义并降解空间控制精度.
为了解决这些问题,我们提出FE-Gen ,它适合高纯度和空间一致的胎儿超声波合成,有两个关键设计: 1)可学习语义查询;2)直方图分布规范. 详情如下。

blocks.en: We employ a three-step fine-tuning strategy to adapt SD to fetal heart ultrasound synthesis, including: (1) SD-VAE adaptation , (2) SD-UNet fine-tuning , and (3) FE-Gen training , inspired by existing adaptation paradigms [ 8 , 12 ] . Fig. 4 shows the whole training process.
blocks.zh: 我们采用三步微调策略来使SD适应胎心超声波合成,包括:(1)SD-VAE适应;(2)SD-UNet微调;和(3)由现有适应范式所启发的FE-Gen训练. [8,12]. 发相. 4显示整个培训过程。

blocks.en: Step-1: SD-VAE Adaptation. For latent diffusion models, the reconstruction quality of VAE decides the upper bound for image fidelity. SD-VAE, pretrained on natural images, is underrepresented for fetal echocardiography and loses fine details, consistent with observations [ 46 ] when adapting SD to specific domain. Therefore, we fine-tune VAE decoder on WHU-4CH-8k with the reconstruction loss L r ​ e ​ c L_{rec} with MSE, perceptual loss L p L_{p} with LPIPS, and GAN loss L G ​ A ​ N L_{GAN} , where ℒ V ​ A ​ E = L r ​ e ​ c + λ 1 ​ L p + λ 2 ​ L G ​ A ​ N , \mathcal{L}_{VAE}=L_{rec}+\lambda_{1}L_{p}+\lambda_{2}L_{GAN}, (9) where loss weights { λ i } i = 1 2 \{\lambda_{i}\}_{i=1}^{2} set empirically following [ 14 ] . We freeze the VAE encoder to keep the latent space unchanged. Table V verifies this adaptation with improved performance.
blocks.zh: 第1步:SD-VAE适应. 对于潜在扩散模型,VAE的重建质量决定了图像忠贞的上限. SD-VAE在自然影像上预受训练,在胎儿回声心电图中代表性不足并失去精细细节,在将SD适应特定领域时与观测结果一致 [46]. 因此,我们对WHU-4CH-8k上的VAE解码器进行微调,将重建损失L r e C L_{rec]与MSE, 感知损失L p_{p]与LPIPS, GAN损失L G A N_{GAN],其中L V A E = L r e C + + → 1 L P + → 2 L G A N,\ mathcal{ L}_{VAE}=L_{L_{c}+\l}+\llamlambda_{1}L_{p}+\lambda}2}L_{GAN}, (9) 损失重量{ λ i}我=1 2 \{\ (Lambdai}\}_{i=i=1}^{2) 实证地跟随 [14]. 我们冻结了VAE编码器 以使潜在的空间保持不变 页:1 V 以更好的性能验证这种适应.

blocks.en: Step-2: SD-UNet Fine-tuning. Since SD, pretrained on natural images, cannot directly produce reasonable and realistic fetal echocardiography and exhibits large distribution gaps, we fine-tune SD-UNet with LoRA [ 47 ] on WHU-4CH-8k for ultrasound synthesis, using a combination of denoising loss and histogram regularization, formulated as, ℒ U ​ N ​ e ​ t = ℒ d ​ e ​ n ​ o ​ i ​ s ​ e + ω h ⋅ ℒ h ​ i ​ s ​ t , \mathcal{L}_{UNet}=\mathcal{L}_{denoise}+\omega_{h}\cdot\mathcal{L}_{hist}, (10) where ω h \omega_{h} denotes the regularization weight. We use a fixed text prompt 𝐜 t \mathbf{c}_{t} as “ A realistic ultrasound image, fetal cardiac, standard four-chamber view. ”. Table V validates the effectiveness of ℒ h ​ i ​ s ​ t \mathcal{L}_{hist} in image fidelity. The fine-tuned SD can generate fetal ultrasound images that better match the real data distribution, serving as the basis for controllable generation.

blocks.en: Step-3: FE-Gen Training. We then train FE-Gen on image-mask pairs from WHU-4CH-Seg517 , initialized with the fine-tuned SD-VAE and SD-UNet, to realize mask-guided fetal heart ultrasound generation, optimized with the same objective as Eq. 10 . The embedding module 𝔼 ⁡ ( ⋅ , ϕ ) \mathbb{E}(\cdot;\phi) and learnable semantic queries { 𝐞 k } k = 1 K \{\mathbf{e}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} are jointly optimized during the training. Empirically, jointly fine-tuning SD-UNet LoRA with FE-Gen yields better performance. Sec. IV-C further investigates the effects of training data scale, classifier-free guidance, and conditioning scale, providing practical guidelines for model configuration. Notably, FE-Gen introduces no additional inference cost compared with the baseline ControlNet.
blocks.zh: 第3步:FE-Gen训练. 然后我们用WHU-4CH-Seg517的图像掩码对阵FE-Gen进行训练,初始化为精制的SD-VAE和SD-UNet,实现由口罩引导的胎儿心超声波生成,与Eq. 10的目标相同. 嵌入式模块 E (⋅, φ)\ mathbb{E} (\cdot;\phi) 和可学习语义查询 { e k} k = 1 K → mathbf{ e}_{k}\}_{k= 1}^{K} 在训练期间被联合优化. 从经验上讲,与FE-Gen联合微调SD-UNet LoRA能产生更好的性能. Sec. IV-C进一步调查了培训数据尺度,无分级指导,和调制尺度的影响,为模型配置提供了实用指南. 值得注意的是,与基线控制网相比,FE-Gen没有引入额外的推论成本.

blocks.en: To evaluate synthesized data on real-world CHD analysis tasks, we select three heterogeneous CHD subtypes—EbA, TAPVC, and VSD—with different incidence rates and prognoses as representatives. We collect extra real positive cases for each subtype with the assistance of experts and consider three distinct settings for evaluation, including:

blocks.en:
(1) Zero-shot classification :
For rare CHDs with poor prognoses and insufficient training positives, we construct two real-world test sets for EbA ( 0.53 % 0.53\% of CHDs) and TAPVC ( 1.50 % 1.50\% of CHDs) referring to clinical reports. CLS-EbA-test84 and CLS-TAPVC-test80 consist of 42/40 normal and 42/40 positive cases from 5 and 7 patients separately. It represents scenarios where no real positives are available for training.
blocks.zh:
(1)零发分级:
对于预后差且培训阳性不足的稀有CDD,我们构建了两套真实世界的测试套,分别针对EbA(0.53%的CDD%)和TAPVC(1.50%的CDD%%),指临床报告. CLS-EbA-test84和CLS-TAPVC-test80分别由5个和7个病人的42/40正常和42/40阳性病例组成. 它代表了没有可供培训的真正阳性因素的情景。

blocks.en:
(2) Lesion detection :
For more prevalent CHD subtypes like VSD ( 35.57 % 35.57\% of CHDs), where a few positives can be collected with effort, we construct DET-VSD-908 , with a training set ( 760 760 negative/ 28 28 positive) and a test set ( 60 60 negative/ 60 60 positive) following [ 48 ] , to evaluate the effectiveness of synthesized samples under severe class imbalance scenarios.
blocks.zh:
(2) Lesion探测:
对于VSD等更流行的CDD亚型(35.57% 35.57\%CHDs),在CHD中可以努力收集出少数正数,我们构建了DET-VSD-908,在[48]后有一套培训(760 760 负/28 28正数)和一套测试(60 负/60正数),以评价在严重阶级失衡情景下合成样品的有效性.

blocks.en:
(3) Anatomy segmentation :
We evaluate synthesized normal samples for fetal cardiac anatomy segmentation using WHU-4CH-Seg517 , where predicted masks can be used for biometric assessment and indicate possible pathologies. To avoid data leakage, data synthesis and augmentation use only automatically detected semantic masks from the DET-VSD-908 training set.
No test images or masks are used to train generative models to ensure fair evaluations.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4-A 2 度量衡

blocks.en:
We evaluate fetal echocardiography generation from three aspects: (1) Reconstruction: PSNR and SSIM for VAE reconstruction quality; (2) Image fidelity: FID and KID measure feature distributions, LPIPS evaluate perceptual similarity, and KL divergence , Skewness , and Standard Deviation quantify histogram distribution differences. We further compute CLIP-Score using pretrained FetalCLIP [ 49 ] with fixed prompts to assess image-text distribution; (3) Image-mask alignment: Dice Similarity Coefficient ( DSC ) of synthesized images, estimated by an nnUNet model pre-trained on the WHU-4CH-Seg517 training set.
For downstream tasks, we use standard metrics: Accuracy, Recall, Precision, AUC for classification; mAP50 for detection; Precision, Recall, DSC, mIoU for segmentation. Each experiment is repeated three times or with 5 5 -fold cross-validation for robust evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们从三个方面评价胎儿回声心电图的生成: (1) 重建:用于VAE重建质量的PSNR和SSIM; (2) 图像忠实度:FID和KID测量特征分布,LPIPS评价知觉相似度,以及KL相差,Skewness,和标准偏差量化直方图分布差异. 我们进一步使用经过预先训练的FetalCLIP [49] 计算出CLIP-Score,并有固定的提示来评估图像-文本分布; (3)图像-面具相接:合成图像的凹痕相似性(DSC),由在WHU-4CH-Seg517训练集上经过预先训练的nnUNet模型估算出.
对于下游任务,我们使用标准衡量标准: 准确性,回想,精度,AUC分类;mAP50检测;精度,回想,DSC,mIoU分出. 每个实验重复三次,或用5个5倍的交叉验证进行强性评价.

All experiments are conducted with PyTorch on four NVIDIA 3090 GPUs. FE-Gen is built on SD v1.5 and ControlNet.
For SD-VAE adaptation, we fine-tune the decoder for 20 epochs with a batch size of 4 and a learning rate of 1 ​ e 1e − - 5 5 .
For SD-UNet adaptation, we adopt a LoRA rank of 8 for fine-tuning 2,000 epochs with a learning rate of 1 ​ e 1e − - 4 4 and a batch size of 16. The noise offset is set to 0.1 [ 50 ] to alleviate contrast flaws, and we randomly drop 30 % 30\% prompts to support classifier-free guidance (CFG).
For FE-Gen, ControlNet is initialized from the UNet encoder and trained for 2,000 epochs with a batch size of 16 and a learning rate of 1 ​ e 1e − - 5 5 . The regularization weight ω h \omega_{h} is set to 0.1 0.1 (see Sec. IV-D1 ). During inference, we adopt CFG = = 2.0 2.0 and conditioning scale λ \lambda = = 1.0 1.0 (see Sec. IV-D3 ).
For downstream tasks, we use ConvNeXt for zero-shot classification, Yolo-v5s for lesion detection, and nnUNet for fetal heart anatomy segmentation following [ 51 , 48 ] with default settings. Sec. IV-B2 provides more details. All experiments are conducted with an image resolution of 512 512 × \times 512 512 unless otherwise specified.

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Image Generation
blocks.zh: IV-B 1 图像生成

blocks.en:
We compare FE-Gen with representative image synthesis methods in Table I : (1) SD-adaptation methods, i.e., DreamBooth [ 52 ] and LoRA [ 47 ] , and (2) spatially controllable generators, i.e. , T2I-Adapter [ 53 ] and ControlNet [ 15 ] . Our baseline is ControlNet ( CtrlNet ).
Notably, text-guided-only methods lack explicit spatial control and cannot follow masks. Our method achieves competitive FID and the lowest LPIPS, and surpasses CtrlNet by 3.96 % 3.96\% DSC, demonstrating superior image-mask alignment for subsequent counterfactual synthesis. Our method also achieves the lowest KL divergence, while others exhibit low standard deviations or large skewness gaps, suggesting reduced image contrast.
Qualitative comparisons in Fig. 5 , histogram distributions in Fig. 6 , and FetalCLIP [ 49 ] feature distributions in Fig. 7 show that our synthesized data exhibit the closest distribution to real ones.
Furthermore, Fig. 8 reports the user study results with 6 6 clinicians with an average 12-year experience in fetal ultrasound. For 20 real and 20 synthesized images of each type (Normal, VSD, EbA, and TAPVC), clinicians are asked to classify them as real or synthesized independently. The overall average accuracy is 46.4 % 46.4\% , comparable to the 50 % 50\% chance level, indicating it is hard to distinguish synthesized samples from real data, reflecting our high perceptual fidelity.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Fig. 14 shows failure cases that do not faithfully exhibit CHD-specific characteristics. Most occur in pseudo-VSD samples, where the IVS remains visually continuous despite the defect specified by the counterfactual mask, attributed to: (1) the inherent stochasticity of diffusion sampling and (2) the difficulty of precise spatial control over subtle, localized structures. Although our method improves spatial alignment over the baseline, precise synthesis of subtle structures remains an important direction for future work.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents Pos4CHD, a positive-free mask-guided counterfactual generation framework for fetal echocardiography, to alleviate CHD data scarcity. We first introduce FE-Gen for ultrasound generation, which mitigates histogram shift via regularization and improves spatial image-mask alignments via learnable semantic queries. Based on FE-Gen, Pos4CHD transforms normal masks into counterfactual ones and generates corresponding images, yielding pseudo-CHD image-mask pairs for downstream analysis. Extensive experiments on synthesized samples exhibit consistent improvements on real-world tasks including zero-shot classification, lesion detection, and anatomy segmentation, demonstrating the potential of synthesized data for automated fetal CHD diagnosis and analysis.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍Pos4CHD,是胎儿回声心电图的正向无口罩导反事实生成框架,以缓解CHD数据稀缺. 我们首先为超声波生成引入了FE-Gen,它通过规范化来缓解直方图的转变,并通过可学习的语义查询来改进空间图像-掩体对齐. 基于FE-Gen,Pos4CHD将普通口罩转化为反事实口罩并生成相应的图像,产生出伪CHD图像-面具对来进行下游分析. 对被合成样品的广泛试验显示,现实世界的任务,包括零发分解、损伤检测和解剖学分解,都得到了一致的改进,显示出合成数据对胎儿的自动CHD诊断和分析的潜力。
